source.title: [ONION / FEDERATION] Voluntary privacy-first registry of independent MyZubster Tor nodes
source.body:
## Goal
Create a **voluntary, privacy-preserving registry of MyZubster installations reachable over Tor Onion**, so we can count *reported and independently checked nodes*, rather than confusing GitHub downloads/stars with live hosting. **No automatic discovery, tracking, telemetry, crawling or deanonymization.** GitHub is the common workspace.

## Current baseline — 27 October 2026
- **MyZubster isolated Onion pilot**: [#1665](https://github.com/MyZubster-Ecosystem/myzubster/issues/1665) documents original Tor v3 service identity and an independent Tor SOCKS HTTP 200 to its *static pilot page*. Status: **operator-documented verified response**, *not full MyZubster/Marketplace availability*.
- **Nicola / N4K48 independently hosted Onion installation**: maintainer reports personally opening it successfully in Tor Browser. Status: **user-reported accessible, independently operated**; exact hostname, consent to list, current version, and repeatable independent check are *not yet recorded*. **Do not publish Nicola's address without his opt-in**.
- **Wasim**: developing Docker/Tor and frontend integration; participation as developer is **not automatically a third public node**.
- **Global total unknown**; two reported installations ≠ two externally audited live nodes.

## Proposed registry fields (public, opt-in only)
`node_id` (operator-chosen identifier), operator's public GitHub handle *or anonymous alias*, project/repository URL if volunteered, node type (self-hosted/experimental), onion hostname **only if the operator explicitly chooses to publish it**, MyZubster version/commit, offered public capabilities (homepage / static gallery / read-only knowledge / etc.), date of operator assertion, consent statement/license, verification method/date and evidence link, current status (**self-reported / independently checked / unreachable / retired**). No identity correlation across sites.

**Do not collect or publish** private Onion keys/hostname files, IPs, SSH/Tailscale details, wallet details, authentication secrets, personal data, connection logs, visitor counts or locations. No mandatory opt-in, online ping or automated phone-home; local installations should continue to work without registration.

## Optional operator registration template
```
REGISTER NODE (opt-in)
Operator pseudonym or GitHub handle:
Public repo/version (optional):
Node description and public services:
Publish .onion address? YES / NO (default NO):
If YES, public onion hostname:
Public evidence of reachability (optional; sanitized):
Consent to display this entry publicly? YES / NO:
```

## Proposed checklist
- [ ] Confirm Nicola's **explicit consent** to be listed (and separately to show hostname). Until then, use only a generic unverified reported-installation count.
- [ ] Draft `docs/federation/ONION-NODE-REGISTRY.md` with scope, schema, consent/withdrawal/verification definitions, threat model and example synthetic entries.
- [ ] Provide an optional GitHub Issue form/template for registrations; default to **not** publishing hostname.
- [ ] Add a small registry view or read-only documentation page showing **reported vs independently checked** counts separately; never describe it as a census of all Tor nodes.
- [ ] Prepare *manual, consent-based* verification checklist using Tor Browser/Tor SOCKS, clear scope, date, homepage and asset checks; avoid retaining logs or sensitive metadata.
- [ ] Optional follow-on: offline Docker Compose self-host Onion proof-of-concept (generate unique identity on first boot, persist volume, print hostname locally); **do not make registration automatic**.
- [ ] Request voluntary review from @nicolaususnicola-lgtm and @wasim-builds; add @gangkor only as optional reviewer if they opt in.
- [ ] Require review before merge; no production changes, budget, bounty, new VPS or wallet work.

## Definition of done
Public, reviewed registry documentation + opt-in template + at least one consented sample/operator entry with its evidence class accurately labeled. **Unknown global usage remains unknown.**

References: #1665, #1584, #1580, #1619.
